Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is immediately generated and sent when there is a PITCH event for a given clock second. If there is no PITCH event for a given clock second, then no Time message is sent for that second. All subsequent time offset fields for the same unit will use the new Time value as the base until another Time message is received for the same unit.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day, derived by converting the current Eastern wall clock time (HH:MM:SS) to seconds.

Message.Name: Complex Instrument Definition Expanded Message
Message.Description: A Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message represents a complex instrument that is available to place orders. This message is unsequenced (sequence = 0) and is sent just prior to every Auction Notification message. Complex Instrument Definition Expanded messages will also be sent in a continuous loop through the day at variable rates as bandwidth allows. The Time offset field should be ignored on Complex Instrument Definition Expanded messages. The Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message will contain two or more repeating groups of leg definitions. There is a limit of 16 leg definitions.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Underlying
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Underlying right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Type
Field.Description: 4 character field; each field describes a characteristic. Character 1: Complex Option Type. O = All legs are options, E = One leg is an equity leg. Characters 2-4: Reserved.

Field.Name: Leg Count
Field.Description: The number of legs in the complex instrument. The maximum number of legs is 16.

Field.Name: Complex Leg
Field.Description: Repeating group of leg definitions, repeats Leg Count times.

Message.Name: Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: A Symbol Mapping message is used to map the 6 character simple instrument multicast feed symbol field to an OSI symbol and Underlying. These messages are not sequenced (sequence = 0) and are sent continuously through the day at variable rates as bandwidth allows.

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol.

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: N = Normal, C = Closing Only.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of underlying equity right padded with spaces. All spaces if not available or not applicable.

Message.Name: Auction Notification Message
Message.Description: Auction Notification messages are used to disseminate order details of a complex auction. Auctions will be available for a defined period of time known as the exposure period.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Auction Notification Auction Type
Field.Description: C = Complex Order Auction (COA) (or Stop Complex Order Auction (SCOA) effective TBD), S = Complex Solicitation Auction Mechanism, B = Complex AIM, O = COA All or None.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: B = Buy, S = Sell.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price. The price field will be populated for all Auctions on EDGX Options, and for Complex SAM Auctions on C1. This field will reflect the auction start price for SPX and SPXW Complex AIMs on C1. For all other Complex AIMs on C1, this field will be set to zero. This field will be set to zero for COA on C1, C2, and BZX.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: N = Non-Customer, C = Customer.

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Executing Broker (optional) of firm attributed to this quote.

Field.Name: Auction End Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last timestamp.

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: Optional user specified value attributed to this quote.

Message.Name: Auction Cancel Message
Message.Description: Auction Cancel messages are used to disseminate the cancellation of an earlier Auction Notification message as a result of a user cancellation of the original complex auction, a user modification request to change the complex auction price or increase the original complex auction quantity, a fading of the NBBO or to cancel any remaining complex auction quantity from the original Auction Notification following the complex auction termination. A user request to modify the complex auction price or to increase the original complex auction quantity will result in a cancellation of the complex auction followed by a new Auction Notification message. Auction Cancel messages will not be issued for complex auction quantity decrements.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Message.Name: Auction Trade Message
Message.Description: Auction Trade messages are used to disseminate executions resulting from a complex auction.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this execution.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity traded.

Message.Name: Options Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Options Auction Update messages are used to disseminate price and size information during the Opening and Re-Opening (halt) process for complex instruments. The Options Auction Update messages are sent every five seconds during an opening period. Refer to the Cboe Options Complex Book Process specification for more information.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument ID
Field.Description: Complex Instrument right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Options Auction Update Auction Type
Field.Description: G = GTH Opening (C1 Only), O = RTH Opening (C1 Only), H = Halt Re-Opening.

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: Not used for complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Buy Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Buy interest at the Indicative Price.

Field.Name: Sell Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Sell interest at the Indicative Price.

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: SNBBO Collared Volume Maximizing Imbalance Minimizing Price computed on combined Auction-Only and Continuous Book (if any).

Field.Name: Auction Only Price
Field.Description: Not used for complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Opening Condition
Field.Description: Not used for Complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Composite Market Bid Price
Field.Description: Not used for Complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Composite Market Offer Price
Field.Description: Not used for complex series. Will contain zero value.

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: Auction Summary messages are used to disseminate the results of the Opening and Re-Opening process of a complex instrument. An Opening or Re-Opening Auction Summary message for each complex instrument is sent at the conclusion of the Opening or Re-Opening process and represents the Cboe opening price. Refer to the Cboe Options Complex Book Process specification for more information.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Summary Auction Type
Field.Description: G = GTH Opening (C1 Only), O = RTH Opening (C1 Only), H = Halt Re-Opening.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Cumulative instrument quantity executed during the auction.

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: The End of Session message is sent for each unit when the unit shuts down. No more auction messages will be delivered for this unit, but heartbeats from the unit may be received.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Group.Name: Complex Leg
Group.Description: Repeating leg definition group inside the Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message. Repeats Leg Count times.

Field.Name: Leg Symbol
Field.Description: Option or Equity Symbol of leg, right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg ratio (positive for buy-side, negative for sell-side). For options this is the number of contracts, for equities this is the number of shares.

Field.Name: Leg Security Type
Field.Description: O = Leg is an Option instrument, E = Leg is an Equity instrument.

Value.Name: Complex Order Auction (COA) (or Stop Complex Order Auction (SCOA) effective TBD)
